payload.outcome: Fixed 2026-09-19 in PR #2920. scripts/run-vitest.mjs now honours HEAVY_RUN_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS and exits 75 with the DATABASE_HEAVY_RUN_ADMISSION_BUSY marker, matching run-heavy.mjs and run-playwright.mjs; an admission refusal is no longer indistinguishable from a failing suite. Two cases added to tests/test-runner-safety.test.ts, which covered only the Playwright runner. Mutation-proved: reverting the fix makes the wait-timeout case hang past 600s on the 15-minute exclusive default. 41 passed.
